findings.label: Missing Task 9 verification worklog
findings.detail: Tasks 3-8 each recorded build/lint/test evidence in a worklog; Task 9 has none, only todo.md build+package checkmarks. Reviewer spot-checked npm run lint and tsc --noEmit on the Task 9 source and both pass clean, so the gap is procedural, not a defect. Recommend adding worklog-task9.md to match the project's own convention.

findings.label: Silent persistence failures (carryover from Task 8 review)
findings.detail: App.tsx still swallows create/save errors in empty catch {} blocks, so a disk-full or unwritable userData leaves the user with no indication their work wasn't saved. Unaddressed in Task 9, consistent with the author's recorded decision to defer it as a product call. A small 'não foi possível salvar' hint on repeated failure would close it.
